per_fold: hold out exactly one TRAIN speaker
use the other 11 TRAIN speakers as calibration rows
fit StandardScaler only on calibration A/S/D
transform calibration rows with that scaler
fit the frozen LogisticRegression only on calibration rows and labels
choose a threshold using calibration rows only
transform the held-out speaker with the calibration scaler
apply the selected threshold once to the held-out speaker
oof_policy: each runtime word occurs in exactly one held-out prediction set
decision: score >= theta -> ADDITION; score < theta -> NON_ADDITION

robust_threshold.definition: ordinary float64 median of the 12 fold calibration thresholds
